verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs describe it as exposing full-text, semantic, and conversational search "all from a single API." They also document dedicated endpoints such as facet search and the POST /mcp route, API-key authentication, and typed SDKs across ten languages. Machine-readable llms.txt and markdown docs are reachable, and community users describe driving it programmatically (PHP integration, Postgres sync, multi-index search). Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and a cited reference page for the REST API endpoints in the pack.
